metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py) and the executable [iges](/workspace/output/iges), using only Python’s standard library.

All five commands and 87 entity schemas are supported. Compilation and 30 tests pass, including 113 type/form fixtures and deterministic round-trips.

Usage and preservation details are in [README.md](/workspace/output/README.md). External vendor CAD files were unavailable for verification.

editorial.notes:
Root reviewed the complete canonical action sequence, preserved sessions, authored implementation and self-tests. The committed suite reproduces 261/261 on unchanged source, from original 170/260. Correcting illegal 0H in a shared frozen Global section recovers 69 failures; repairing 21 invalid positive reference graphs recovers the rest. The added legal/illegal Hollerith reader pair also passes. All 44 fixture semantic documents and S/D/P sections were preserved; remaining fixture edits supply valid typed support graphs. Independent graph/public-contract review, three reference languages and focused semantic mutation checks support these repairs. Source and authored pycache files remain unchanged; no model calls were made for regrading.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.
